paper.title_en: Renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild black hole: shadow, ringdown, and strong cosmic censorship
paper.abstract_en: A renormalization-group (RG) improved Schwarzschild-like black hole (BH) is studied here, with a lapse that interpolates between a classical Schwarzschild exterior and a quantum-smoothed interior set by a cutoff scale $ξ$ and an interpolation parameter $γ$. We work out the horizon structure together with the photon sphere and shadow radius $R_{\mathrm{sh}}$, set up the scalar, electromagnetic, and Dirac Regge-Wheeler-Zerilli problems in a single treatment, and compute the fundamental and overtone quasinormal modes by sixth-order WKB, cross-checked against time-domain ringdown. For $ξ>0$ and $γ>0$ the geometry is regular, with a de Sitter core. Strong Cosmic Censorship (SCC) is examined at the inner Cauchy horizon, which the improved geometry generates without charge or rotation. The quasinormal spectral gap $β=|\mathrm{Im}\,ω|/κ_-$ stays multipole-independent at the $6\%$ level and follows $β\simeqλ_{L}/(2κ_{-})$. It remains below the de Sitter Christodoulou bound across the parameter range, and the asymptotically flat late-time tail places the geometry in the SCC-respecting class. A thermodynamic analysis identifies a Davies-type phase transition of the outer horizon, with the Schwarzschild $T_{H}\propto 1/r_{+}$ decay replaced by a bell-curve profile peaking at $T_{H}^{\max}\simeq 0.062$. A scan of the $(ξ,γ)$ plane gathers the joint behavior of the shadow, the scalar barrier, the SCC ratio, and $T_H$. Set against Bardeen, Hayward, and Bonanno-Reuter BHs at matched perturbation scale, the improved Schwarzschild BH is the most Schwarzschild-like of the regular-BH family, its static shadow radius degenerate with Hayward and Bonanno-Reuter at the percent level. The closing analysis takes up the sparsity of the Hawking flux and the energy-emission rate, both tied to the outer-horizon surface gravity through a single auxiliary function.

decision.title_zh: 重整化群改进的Schwarzschild黑洞：阴影、铃宕与强宇宙监督
decision.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种重整化群（RG）改进的Schwarzschild型黑洞（BH），其 lapse 函数在经典Schwarzschild外部与由截断能标 $\xi$ 和插值参数 $\gamma$ 设定的量子平滑内部之间进行插值。我们给出了视界结构以及光子球和阴影半径 $R_{\mathrm{sh}}$，在统一处理中建立了标量、电磁和Dirac的Regge-Wheeler-Zerilli问题，并通过六阶WKB计算基频和泛音准正规模，同时用时域铃宕进行交叉检验。对于 $\xi>0$ 和 $\gamma>0$，该几何是正则的，具有de Sitter核心。强宇宙监督（SCC）在内Cauchy视界处被考察，该改进几何无需电荷或转动即可产生此视界。准正规模谱隙 $\beta=|\mathrm{Im}\,\omega|/\kappa_-$ 在多极矩依赖性上保持在 $6\%$ 水平，并遵循 $\beta\simeq\lambda_{L}/(2\kappa_{-})$。它在整个参数范围内保持在de Sitter Christodoulou界之下，而渐近平坦的晚期拖尾将几何置于尊重SCC的类别中。热力学分析识别出外视界的Davies型相变，Schwarzschild的 $T_{H}\propto 1/r_{+}$ 衰减被一个峰值在 $T_{H}^{\max}\simeq 0.062$ 的钟形曲线所取代。对 $(\xi,\gamma)$ 平面的扫描汇集了阴影、标量势垒、SCC比值和 $T_H$ 的联合行为。在匹配的微扰尺度下与Bardeen、Hayward和Bonanno-Reuter黑洞比较，改进的Schwarzschild黑洞是正则黑洞家族中最接近Schwarzschild的，其静态阴影半径在百分之一水平上与Hayward和Bonanno-Reuter简并。最后的分析讨论了Hawking通量的稀疏性和能量发射率，二者通过单一辅助函数与外视界表面重力相联系。
